Y01.text:
• The document is a circular from Kaveri State University regarding the conduct of End Semester Examinations for B.Tech, M.Tech, and MBA programmes in 2026. • The exams will start on 24 November 2026 and end on 12 December 2026. • The detailed timetable will be published on the university website by 5 November 2026. • The examination fee for regular students is Rs. 1,800 per semester, with an additional Rs. 350 for supplementary papers. Payments must be made through the online student portal. • The last date for payment without a fine is 7 November 2026, with a late fine of Rs. 500 accepted until 14 November 2026.
The document outlines the examination regulations for Kaveri State University. Key points include: students must have a minimum 75% attendance to be eligible for exams, hall tickets are available for download from November 18, 2026, students must report 30 minutes before the exam with a valid hall ticket, and results will be declared in the second week of January 2027. Students with attendance below 65% will be detained, and those using electronic devices in the examination hall will face disciplinary action.

Y02.text:
• The document is an admission notice for full-time M.Tech programs at the Deccan Institute of Technology for the 2027-28 academic year. • The notice invites eligible candidates with specific academic qualifications to apply. • Candidates must apply by 31 July 2027, with no upper age limit. • Application fees vary based on candidate categories. • Eligibility criteria include minimum aggregate marks or CGPA requirements.
Answer: This document outlines the application process for a program. Key points include: applications open on 2 January 2027, with a deadline of 15 February 2027. The DIT Entrance Test (DET) is scheduled for 7 March 2027 in three cities. Selection is based on a combination of test scores (70%) and personal interviews (30%). Candidates with a valid GATE score above 500 are exempt from the entrance test. The counseling and seat allotment are from 10 April to 14 April 2027. The tuition fee is Rs. 95,000 per year, and candidates must apply online at a specified portal, bringing certain documents to the counseling session.

Y03.text:
• The document is an invitation for the Merit-cum-Means Scholarship for undergraduate students in the first year of degree programmes in recognized colleges and universities in the State of Vindhya for the academic year 2026-27. • The scholarship amount is Rs. 25,000 per annum, with a one-time book allowance of Rs. 5,000 in the first year. • Eligibility criteria include being a permanent resident of Vindhya, scoring at least 75% in Class XII, and having an annual family income not exceeding Rs. 2,50,000. • The scholarship is for students not already receiving any other government scholarship. • The notification number is VSSB/2016-27/12, and the document is a synthetic sample for DocuBharat testing.
• The document outlines the application process for a State Scholarship in a specific state, with a registration deadline of 31 December 2026 and a selection list publication on 15 February 2027. • Applicants must submit their Class XII mark sheet, income certificate, residence certificate, bank passbook, and admission receipt. • Scholarships are renewable annually provided the student passes all subjects and maintains at least 80% attendance. • False information submission results in disqualification and recovery of the scholarship amount. • Contact information for assistance is provided, including a toll-free number and email address.

Y04.text:
The document outlines the fee structure for Narmada College of Engineering for the 2026-27 academic year. It specifies fees for tuition, development, library, examination, and optional hostel rent and mess advance. The total fees are Rs. 59,000 for day scholars and Rs. 1,12,000 for hostel residents. Payments are due by 31 July 2026, with a late fee for payments between 1 August and 20 August 2026. Non-payment will result in the cancellation of registration for the semester.
• The document outlines the mode of payment for fees at Narmada College of Engineering, which includes payment through the college portal or by NEFT to the college account. • Students can apply for a 50% tuition fee concession if their annual family income is below Rs. 1,00,000 and must submit an income certificate by 15 July 2026. • Refunds are available for withdrawals before 31 August 2026, with a processing charge of Rs. 1,000. No refunds are given for withdrawals after this date. • For fee-related queries, students should contact the Accounts Section at accounts@nce.example.ac.in or 0755-2661-450. • The document is issued by the Finance Officer of Narmada College of Engineering.

Y05.text: Purpose: Announce a free Digital Literacy Training Programme for citizens of Vindhya. Key dates: Registration from 1 December to 20 December 2026, training starts on 5 January 2027. Required actions: Residents aged 18-60, able to read in English, Hindi, or regional language, can register online or at a Common Service Centre. Eligibility: No fee for those who complete the training and pass the final assessment.

Y06.text:
• The document is a notice from the Dean, Student Welfare at Godavari University regarding hostel accommodation for the 2026-27 academic year. • Students must apply online by 25 June 2026. • Allotment will be based on distance from home and academic merit. • The hostel admission fee is Rs. 4,500, non-refundable, and the annual room rent is Rs. 38,000, payable by 15 July 2026. • Applications must be submitted through the online portal.
• The document outlines instructions for students with allotted rooms to report to the Chief Warden's office by a specified date with necessary documents. • The key dates mentioned are between 20 July 2026 and 25 July 2026. • Students must submit an allotment letter, two photographs, and a medical fitness certificate. • Rooms not occupied by 25 July 2026 will be allotted to wait-listed students. • For further information, a contact email is provided.
